title: A monster's telegraphed kit cast (slam, lunge, roar)
oneLine: A monster's signature cast: ready, winding up, executing, cooling; cancelled by stun, parry, respawn.
topConcern: A blue slime killed mid-lunge-windup still lunges from its 0-HP swelling corpse; the split boss's swell also leaves its cast running.

title: A blue slime's death swell (the deferred kill)
oneLine: Kill deferred 1.6 s while the slime swells at 0 HP, then the blast and the replayed kill.
topConcern: The swell clears only the basic wind-up: the kit cast and a thrown ball run on through the swell into the next life.

title: A monster's ball in the air (snowball, slime ball)
oneLine: Thrown ball: aim point and release frozen, lands after travelMs if the target stayed near.
topConcern: Not cleared on death, swell or respawn: a ball thrown just before a kill lands from the respawned monster about 19 s later.

title: The melee lifesteal ledger (what each monster has dealt you)
oneLine: Per player, the damage each monster id dealt; refunded 90% on your melee kill of that id.
topConcern: Cleared only on zone change or death, and the Wheel is one zone: a respawned monster's previous-life damage is refunded.

title: A monster's basic swing or throw wind-up
oneLine: Stamp-then-resolve basic attack: wind-up, re-measured whiff, then a swing hit or a ball release.
topConcern: An elemental freeze during the wind-up stops movement but not the stamped swing; only a stun or a parry cancels it.

title: The snowman's burrow (dig, pile, emerge)
oneLine: Snowman at half HP digs, becomes an invulnerable chasing pile, emerges vulnerable; a facing shield bonks it early.
topConcern: The pile ignores crowd control while it grinds after you.

title: The giant slime boss's splits
oneLine: Boss health floored at each quarter mark; it swells unhittable, blasts, spawns slimes and shrinks, three times.
topConcern: The split swell stops the boss script and basic wind-up but not its fodder lunge kit or a monster move in flight.

title: May this monster be hit? (the damage-denial gate)
oneLine: One predicate (alive, hp, split floor, invulnerable window) that every monster damage door should ask.
topConcern: Element Burst and the staff splash pick targets by alive and hp only, so the burst stamps statuses on an invulnerable pile or boss.

title: A monster's death and its settlement (credit, loot, XP, heals, traps)
oneLine: Kill: credit shares, loot pile, kill roll, heals, XP, quests, codex, traps, respawn clock, contributions cleared.
topConcern: Eight entry points plus a deferred replay behind a set-and-clear latch; a new await or skipped path breaks settlement.

title: A player taking damage (grace, god mode, dodge, Last Stand, Second Wind)
oneLine: The one place player HP drops: grace and god windows, dodge, cuts, Last Stand, Second Wind.
topConcern: Callers, not _applyDamage, check ps.dying; harmless today.

title: A monster's blow through the one door, and the shield that meets it
oneLine: Fifteen kinds of monster blow, one ordered pipeline: shield, shelter, miss, block or parry, dice, after-effects, death.
topConcern: A blocked monster blow that empties stamina does not break the guard, unlike PvP, leaving about 0.66 s of free blocks.

title: Proof a hit on a monster was earned (cadence lanes, hit-rate bucket, paid special windows)
oneLine: Per-player cadence lanes, ranged hit-rate tokens and paid special windows gating monster_damage claims.

title: A player's blow at a player (lag-comp rewind, lanes, block, parry, guard break)
oneLine: PvP claim resolved against rewound positions, consent, per-pair lanes, block, parry, guard break and the worker's roll.
topConcern: The attacker's death gate runs before a thorn recoil that can kill them, so a dead attacker's blow still lands.

title: Element statuses on a monster and the hold rule
oneLine: Per-monster statuses with durations, stacks, DoT ticks and collisions; freeze or root holds, then immunity.
topConcern: Durations count ticks but DoTs count wall time; refreshes move credit; the burst stamps statuses on protected monsters.

title: The collision resonance streak
oneLine: Resonating collisions build a 10 s streak that pays mana, throttled to once every 3 s.

title: Stamina abilities, lunge and Element Burst: cooldowns and the whirlwind's wind-up
oneLine: Per-kind cooldown stamps and a 1 s armed whirlwind, paid at the press, struck from where you stand.
topConcern: An armed whirlwind is not re-checked for a parry stagger when it fires.

title: Ground fire: the fire goblin's trail and a burning heap
oneLine: Per-zone fire patches arming, burning and expiring; one burn tick per player per 500 ms.
topConcern: Per-player burn clocks and dungeon zones' patch arrays are never freed; dungeon cleanup skips fireTrails.

title: Sticky aggro and knockback debt
oneLine: A hit pulls the monster onto its attacker for 10 s; shoves leave a capped debt repaid while chasing.

title: One roll a kill
oneLine: Each kill rolls 1 to 10,000; the drop it lands on is minted, then told to whoever may have it.

title: The bow special's final blast (arrow_blast)
oneLine: Retired coordinate-named blast, refused while the volley is live, with a cooldown and a refusal ledger.
topConcern: The refusal ledger is never pruned (tiny).

title: A dropped bag item on the ground
oneLine: Dropped pile: private 60 s, revealed to the room, flashing at 120 s, gone at 130 s.
topConcern: A restart in those two minutes loses the item (documented and accepted).

title: A socket's door and message budget
oneLine: Per-socket message tokens, a join deadline, one join per socket and per-address open limits.

title: Paced writes (a player's own taps saved at a bounded rate)
oneLine: Per lane and player token buckets; past the burst the latest write is held and flushed later.
topConcern: A held mute-list write lives only in a setTimeout; a deploy in that window loses it.

title: Which shield is on the arm, and the gem in it
oneLine: Worn shield versus carried ones, with a session-only arm-known flag that No man's land trusts.

title: A weapon's gem slots and the Enchanting XP a made gem is owed
oneLine: A weapon goes plain, one gem, two gems (fusion); Take out strips both; made gems owe 400 XP.

title: The one-formula switch thrown while players are on
oneLine: Global formula flag; flipping it re-sizes every live bar and monster hit from a per-monster stamp.
topConcern: Phones keep the caps they joined with and predict the old formula until they rejoin.

title: In a fight (the stamps behind out-of-combat healing and the safe ground's shelter)
oneLine: Damage taken and dealt stamps decide regen, safe-ground heal and shelter; PvP and No man's land keep other clocks.
topConcern: Several in-a-fight clocks serve different readers; DoT, splash and collision damage dealt never stamp _lastDealtAt.

title: A blow ends your harvest (the combat side of the extraction machine)
oneLine: Any monster_damage or PvP claim deletes the sender's extraction record, before the claim's own weapon, reach and rate gates.
topConcern: Stuck-arrow chip claims keep arriving 2.5-4 s after a bow special and end a harvest begun meanwhile; its strike is then refused.
